visual_validation.manual_screenshot_review: Desktop/mobile first screen, CPU and heartbeat sections, methods, and dated fleet header; no clipping or overflow observed.

source_revision_scope: Pinned effective devel source plus recorded per-arm experiment patches. Production PRs use current devel and exclude snapshot/helper diagnostics.
sampling_design: Eight final observations: four immutable CPU2/CPU4 clones and four balanced heartbeat control/candidate observations. The two heartbeat controls are the shared CPU1 controls, counted once. Seeds and all known failures/retries/cancellations are retained separately.
handler_heartbeat_experiment: Complete: stale/ineligible recovery exercised twice, but both controls scheduled normally; no net latency improvement established. Handler helper not selected for publication.
post_merge_soak_measurement: Not collected for the proposed CPU or monitor changes. Earlier fleet distributions are explicitly frozen, not post-treatment.

frozen_fleet_manifest.post_merge_soak_measurement: Early follow-up measured; no originating k3s execution in the cohort contains the storage cleanup fix. Full 48-hour soak pending.
frozen_fleet_manifest.sampling_design: Chronological exact-head PR arrival cohort plus a separate bounded completed mainline originating-physical-action cohort; controlled experiments are separate and are not a matched fleet treatment estimate.
frozen_fleet_manifest.handler_heartbeat_experiment: Completed bounded trial was inconclusive: both arms rebuilt cold, the warm-only refresh path never ran, and both targets failed guest boot-evidence teardown. No handler restart implementation or latency gain is claimed.
